input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone. It’s been happening for the past few hours, and I’d really like to get it working again. Can you help me figure out what’s going on?
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information from me.

It looks like my phone currently cannot send MMS messages, and I also noticed that my network status shows no service, with airplane mode turned on and the SIM card status as missing. What should I do next to get this working?

I followed your instructions: I turned off airplane mode and reinserted my SIM card. Now my phone shows the SIM card is active and I have a poor 2G signal, but mobile data is still disabled. I still can’t send MMS messages. What should I try next?
I’ve turned on mobile data as you suggested. What should I do next to change the network mode preference?

I’ve changed my network mode to prefer 4G and 5G, and now my phone shows an excellent 5G signal with mobile data enabled. However, I still can’t send MMS messages. Is there something else I should try?

I ran the check on my APN settings. The current APN name is set to "internet," but the MMSC URL for picture messages is not set. Does this mean I need to update my APN settings to get MMS working? If so, could you guide me through what needs to be changed?
I’ve reset my APN settings as you suggested. You mentioned that I need to reboot my device for the changes to take effect. Should I go ahead and restart my phone now?
I’ve restarted my phone after resetting the APN settings, but unfortunately, I still can’t send MMS messages. Is there anything else I should try?
I checked and Wi-Fi Calling was turned on, so I switched it off as you suggested. However, I still can’t send MMS messages. Is there another step I should try?
The messaging app I’m using is simply called “messaging.” What should I check next regarding its permissions?
I checked the permissions for the messaging app, and it currently has SMS and phone permissions enabled, but not storage. Should I go ahead and enable storage permission for the app?
I’ve enabled the storage permission for the messaging app, but I still can’t send MMS messages. Is there anything else I should try?
